tools.name: find_place
tools.description: Find a Spanish municipality, province or comunidad autónoma by name and get its place_id. Accepts any spelling; works best with the official Spanish name (e.g. "Marbella", "Palma", "Jávea" / "Xàbia", "Islas Baleares"). Returns candidates with the regions they belong to. Pass queries to look up sever

tools.name: get_rules
tools.description: Property rules in force for a place in Spain, resolved up the chain municipality → comunidad → state: rates, scales, reductions, deadlines, rental and tourist-rental regimes, with official source, check date and tier per figure. Filter by topic: purchase (Buying: transfer tax (ITP), stamp duty (AJD)

tools.name: get_rule_history
tools.description: The dated sequence of values of one rule at one place (for example how a town's IBI rate changed), each with its source. (Historial de una norma: cómo ha cambiado el IBI o la plusvalía de un municipio.)

tools.name: get_recent_changes
tools.description: Rules recorded since a date, from a daily watch of the BOE and the regional and provincial bulletins (cambios recientes de normativa: BOE, boletines autonómicos y provinciales). Optionally limited to one place and the regions above it.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: How complete our municipal data is for a place: verified from the official ordinance text, from the Ministerio de Hacienda file only, or none; and which core keys are missing.

tools.name: compare_rule
tools.description: One rule across every municipality of a comunidad or provincia (or a list of place_ids), in one call: its value in each, with source, check date and tier. Suited to portfolio and "where can I…" questions, e.g. key alquiler_turistico_licencias over a province (where new tourist rentals are allowed) o
